title: dioscorea hispida var. reticulata
intro: Dioscorea hispida var. reticulata, commonly known as the netted yam, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dioscoreaceae. This plant is a type of yam that is native to tropical Asia and is known for its edible tubers and various medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dioscorea hispida var. reticulata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a phytoestrogen that has been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-osteoporotic effects.
